item.title: Watch the Battlefield 6 Season 2 gameplay reveal here
item.description: After a one-month delay, we’re finally days away now from the start of Battlefield 6’s Season 2 of live service. The second season is being revealed today, following weeks of teasers, and some Battlefield Labs testing of the first new map arriving with the new season. Read more

item.title: You're not crazy, trying to heal in Nioh 3 sometimes doesn't work - and Team Ninja is fixing it
item.description: Nioh 3 has received a hot new update that brings plenty of bug fixes to very specific issues, but it also implements fixes for a few of the most common - and incredibly annoying - bugs. Patch 1.03.01 arrived earlier on all platforms, and it comes with a chunky set of notes. Read more

item.title: Genshin Impact Luna 5 takes the squad back to Mondstadt, finally makes Varka playable
item.description: The latest big content update has been revealed for HoYoverse's breakout game, Genshin Impact. Version Luna 5, which has the unusually long and needlessly layered title — Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation - Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind — is set to arrive February 25. Read more

item.title: Nioh 3 is, unsurprisingly, the fastest-selling game in the series with over a million units sold
item.description: Even before the game came out, it was pretty easy to guess that Nioh 3 would be a hit. From the word of mouth leading up to launch, to the well-received free demo, there was little chance the action RPG wasn’t going to be a major deal. Read more

item.title: The Sims 4 developer hasn't forgotten about its quality of life commitment, and is back with an update on what to expect in 2026
item.description: As the The Sims 4 continues into its second decade, the volume of new content, major expansions, and long-awaited features has grown in lockstep. Unfortunately, that has also meant that, given how old the game is, a few technical problems remain a nuisance. Read more

item.title: Genshin Impact fans on PS4 only have six weeks to find another platform as support winds down with one final update
item.description: Version Luna 5 of Genshin Impact is now live, but it's a bittersweet occasion for fans of HoYoverse's breakout gacha RPG – at the very least, those who are still playing the game on PlayStation 4, which is presumably true of somebody out there. Read more

item.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin may be your next anime gacha obsession, with a hint of Ghibli, and this latest trailer may be what sells you on it
item.description: It seems like we’re getting one of these every few months, but the world of mobile action RPGs that look like the games that, just a few years back, were only possible on consoles is expanding with another new entry. Read more

item.title: Marathon may actually have a shot as Server Slam hits it big on Steam
item.description: Things are officially looking better for Marathon. The game’s Server Slam, essentially an open beta that’s freely available everywhere, has kicked off. This is the last chance for anyone curious about Bungie’s next big game to play it before it officially goes on sale next week. Read more

item.title: The Sims 4 is getting paid mods, and a new in-game currency to pay for them
item.description: The Sims 4 has officially entered into its paid mods era. Developer Maxis announced The Sims Maker Program, and The Sims 4 Marketplace - two new destinations to publish, and discover new add-on content. Read more

item.title: Our first look at Diablo 4's Warlock and the game's next season arrive in today's livestream - watch it here
item.description: Diablo 4’s next, long-awaited Developer Update finally airs today. This meaty livestream was first announced nearly a month ago, when Blizzard initially revealed that the game’s next class is the Warlock. Read more
